_Do you want to shape how software, data, and AI create the next generation of customer value at Kamstrup? Are you ready to connect our strategy with customer needs and technology to transform opportunities into new ways of working?

_**Lead the future of Software & Analytics in Water

**As Vice President of Software & Analytics you will be responsible for defining and driving the future of Kamstrup’s software offerings within our Water business. As a key member of the Water Leadership Team, you will help shape what we build, how we organize, prioritize, and operate to create value in a rapidly changing digital landscape. You will lead a transformation agenda that brings together strategy, organization, capabilities, technology, and products, ensuring that we are ready to capture the opportunities with long-term business objectives and customer needs.

More specifically, you will:

• Defining and executing the software and analytics strategy, setting clear priorities, translating business ambitions and customer needs into clear strategic priorities, choices, and measurable outcomes

• Leading the transformation towards an AI-enabled business, identifying where it can fundamentally change our products, customer experience, development practices, and ways of working

• Translating customer needs into scalable digital solutions, combining software, data, analytics, and AI to address real customer challenges, and create measurable value

• Shaping the organization and capabilities needed to build right structures, leadership capabilities, competencies, and ways of working to accelerate innovation and execution

• Driving effective prioritization and investment decisions, including resource allocation, development cost awareness, strategic partnerships, and sourcing models

As AI and data-driven technologies are rapidly changing customer expectations, product architectures, and business models, we are looking for a visionary yet execution-focused Vice President of Software & Analytics business to lead a fundamental transformation of how software, data, and AI create value within our Water business. This is a unique opportunity to define and shape where we need to go, transform how we work, and build the capabilities needed to compete in a world increasingly shaped by AI.

**Meet your future team

**With a direct reference to the Senior Vice President - Water, you will be leading a Software & Analytics organization consisting of more than 50 software and analytics professionals.

As a member of the Water Leadership Team, you will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer value creation. You will collaborate closely with Product Management and Technology Metering Solutions & Connectivity to ensure a coherent, future‑proof software strategy across hardware, data, and digital services.

You will also play an important role in creating synergies and alignment across Kamstrup’s businesses leveraging shared technologies, capabilities, data, and digital opportunities where this creates value.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a visionary and customer-focused leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution. You are comfortable navigating complexity, challenging status quo, and creating alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. At the same time, you are an inclusive leader who knows how to build strong teams, develop leaders, and create an environment where people can perform and innovate.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Bring extensive senior or executive leadership experience within software development, digital platforms, or software-enabled products

• Have a proven track record of leading complex business and technology transformations, balancing strategic direction with operational execution

• Possess a strong customer-centric mindset and the ability to translate customer needs into innovative software, analytics, and digital solutions

• Demonstrate deep expertise in modern software architectures, cloud technologies, data platforms, analytics, AI, and cybersecurity, with the ability to translate technology opportunities into business value

• Excel at building high-performing organizations and developing leaders, while driving strategic decisions on priorities, partnerships, sourcing models, and investments

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your motivated resume by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The position is located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, Denmark, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Data Management Consultant

• Full-time

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

**System Architect (Principal) – Shape the Future of Medical Device Innovation

**Would you like to help drive the transformation from product-centric to platform-centric development in global innovate medtech company?

Then we offer you an opportunity to join a highly skilled R&D environment where collaboration, learning, and innovation go hand in hand. Your role will drive how we work with system architecture, requirements, modularization, and platform building across the organization – while contributing to products that make a difference for our users every day.

At Coloplast, we work every day to improve the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs. And you will play a key role in bringing our strategy to life by helping shape the future of how we develop innovative medical devices.

**Join a team shaping the future of R&D

**You will become part of our Requirements Engineering Team, which forms an essential part of our new Centre of Excellence in R&D, bringing together almost 500 talented colleagues.

In your new team, you will meet 7 colleagues who are global process owners of regulated medical device processes and our system architects driving our large strategic development projects.

Together, we define and improve ways of working across R&D to enable ambitious innovation to reach our users faster through a more structured and scalable development approach.

And of course, we make sure to have fun along the way.

**Lead the development of the System Architecture discipline

**As our new Principal System Architect, you will lead the development of the system architecture discipline and help position it for the future. This means you will lead Coloplast’s journey from developing individual products towards platform building and building up competences within system architecture discipline.

Specifically, you will:

• Lead and support the implementation of platform-based product development and manufacturing process development.

• Strengthen and mature the system architecture discipline by defining and evolving processes, methods, and best practices.

• Contribute to building system architecture capabilities across the organisation through training, sparring, coaching and knowledge sharing.

• Shape and communicate the value of system architecture as part of ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Build alignment across stakeholders in a complex, cross-functional environment by engaging, listening, and creating shared understanding.

• Driving results through colleagues, including other system architects, project managers, program managers and system engineers, in a motivating and engaging way.

• Contribute hands-on to development projects as a trusted architecture resource, working closely with teams to define and deliver system architecture artefacts (e.g. system design, interface specifications, functional analysis and impact analysis)

• Translate inputs from across the business (e.g. commercial, regulatory, manufacturing) into clear and usable system architecture decision and artefacts, ensuring different perspectives are reflected

• Ensure system architecture is effectively integrated with related development disciplines such as requirements engineering, test, and documentation management

**Solid Experience In System Architecture For Physical Product Development

**You are a team player, with strong communication skills and the ability to communicate clearly and concisely as you manage stakeholders across a complex and large organization. Moreover, you have the ability to balance and consider cross-functional concerns in decision-making, and you take a coaching leadership approach to support and develop colleagues and stakeholders.

While experience from the medical device industry is valuable, we also welcome candidates with a strong systems engineering and architecture background from other complex product development industries such as aerospace, defense, industrial automation, robotics, windmill industry or advanced consumer products.

**What We Expect From You

**

• 7+ years of experience in system architecture, preferably for physical products and hardware-based systems, not solely software.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and a proven ability to drive alignment across functions, disciplines, and organizational levels.

• Comfortable working across engineering, product management, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and other key functions.

• Experience leading or influencing organizational change, including the implementation of new ways of working, processes, or engineering practices.

• Ability to provide technical leadership, coaching, and architectural guidance to teams and stakeholders.

• Extensive hands-on experience with systems engineering for complex products, including system architecture, requirements management, interface management, verification, and validation.

• Proven experience establishing, evolving, and governing system architecture and systems engineering practices.

• Experience with modular architecture, product platforms, and reusable architecture strategies.

• Strong knowledge and practical application of systems engineering principles, methods, and best practices, including recognized industry frameworks such as INCOSE.

• Experience contributing directly to development projects and delivering architecture artefacts from concept through implementation.

• Proven experience operating in regulated product development environments and balancing technical, quality, risk, regulatory, and design control requirements.

• Ability to translate diverse business, user, and technical needs into clear architecture decisions and system-level solutions.

• Strong architectural judgement and ability to balance commercial, technical, regulatory, manufacturing, and user considerations.

• Experience defining system boundaries, interfaces, and reusable architectural building blocks that support platform-based product development.

• Motivated by both shaping long-term architectural direction and contributing to successful day-to-day product delivery.

**You might also bring

**

• Experience from medical device development or other highly regulated industries.

• Knowledge of relevant standards and frameworks such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, or equivalent.

• Understanding manufacturing, industrialization, and production processes, ensuring architectures are scalable, manufacturable, testable, and cost-effective throughout the product lifecycle.

• Experience supporting product strategy through platform thinking, technology roadmaps, and long-term architecture planning.

Please note: Seniority level will be determined based on your experience (principal, senior principal)

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Head of Requirement Engineering, Centre of Excellence, R&D, Stine Renberg at +45 49113320. We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Please note: Stine is back from holiday 27th July.

**Join a team of highly skilled Data & AI specialists and help build the platforms that power the future of data, analytics and AI across the organisation. If you are passionate about modern data platforms, AI technologies and platform engineering, this is an opportunity to shape scalable solutions while enabling others to innovate and deliver impact at scale.

****Meet your future team

**You will join the Data & AI Platforms team, responsible for the shared foundation that supports data, analytics and AI use cases across the organisation.

The team owns and develops the core Data & AI platform landscape, including our Snowflake-based data platform, dbt, GenAI Hub, AI Gateway, Cortex Agents and emerging agentic AI capabilities. We continuously evaluate new technologies, tools and ways of working to provide secure, scalable and developer-friendly platforms that empower teams across the business.

As a Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer, you will play a central role in designing, building and operating these platforms. You will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, AI Solutions Partners, Data Scientists and other technology specialists, helping them build and deploy data products and AI solutions efficiently and securely.

**What We Offer

**As a Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer, you will take ownership of core platform capabilities within both Data and AI. You will work hands-on with modern technologies while influencing platform architecture, engineering standards and future technology choices.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Build, operate and continuously evolve our Snowflake and dbt-based Data Platform, enabling teams to develop, deploy and operate data products and AI applications independently.

• Design and develop core Data & AI platform capabilities, including Cortex Agents, AI governance, observability, security, access management and developer experience.

• Define platform architecture, engineering standards and best practices across the Data & AI landscape.

• Drive reliability, scalability and cost optimisation across Data and AI workloads, including FinOps initiatives and platform governance.

• Coach and support Data Engineers and AI Solutions Partners by promoting reusable building blocks, platform patterns and engineering best practices.

**What You Will Bring

**You are an experienced platform engineer who enjoys building robust foundations that others can build on. You thrive in complex technical environments, stay curious about emerging technologies and are motivated by enabling teams through scalable platform capabilities.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Have 5+ years of experience designing, building and operating production-grade data platforms.

• Bring deep expertise in Snowflake and dbt.

• Have strong Python skills and experience working with SQL, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices.

• Have experience with modern AI and LLM infrastructure, such as model gateways, retrieval systems and agent frameworks.

• Understand data mesh principles, semantic modelling and data contracts.

• Have experience supporting large numbers of users while balancing reliability, security and cost efficiency.

• Enjoy collaborating with and mentoring other engineers and technical stakeholders.

• Have a structured and pragmatic approach to solving complex technical challenges.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**In the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Experienced Backend Developer for UBsend A/S

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Travel: Approximately 10-30 days per year

Looking for the next step in your career?

Do you have 4-5 years+ of experience as a software developer? Are you eager to play a central role in a highly skilled team? Do you want to work with the latest technologies on a cloud-native platform and be part of an exciting scale-up company with the potential to disrupt the transportation and logistics industry?

If so, our IT department in Copenhagen is looking for an ambitious, dedicated and skilled backend developer to build and maintain a best-in-class IT solution.

Who is UBsend?

UBsend is a scale-up company aiming for developing and implementing state-of-the-art logistic solutions within the parcel industry. We ensure that companies of all sizes receive optimal solutions for their parcels in terms of carrier selection, lead time, prices, track and trace and customer experience. We strive to be the leading integration platform, growing rapidly and working with many well-known B2B and B2C clients. We are a company with a multinational culture, counting roughly 80 employees between our offices in Aarhus and Copenhagen. We keep the daily motivation high through social events and a down-to-earth tone with lots of humor and an inclusive atmosphere.

The IT Department

You will join our IT department of 22 colleagues. The department is responsible for developing new products and components and maintaining existing integrations between carriers and customers. Projects and solutions you will work on include:

• Development and implementation of a new enterprise platform in microservice architecture

• Development of carrier and transportation integrations

• Track and trace and event management

Our solutions are developed with an object-oriented approach, utilizing software design patterns when relevant. We aim to deliver the best solutions for our customers while enjoying an informal culture. We use Scrum methodologies and apply test-driven and domain-driven development with API-first approaches.

Key Technologies

Our technology stack includes:

• Languages & Frameworks: Java 17+21, Spring Boot, NodeJS, TypeScript, Angular CLI

• Data & Messaging: Confluent Kafka, Spring Data, MongoDB, Elasticsearch

• Infrastructure: Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, Terraform, Helm, Azure, Maven, BitBucket + Pipelines, Grafana

The position

Your main task will be to develop and maintain state-of-the-art applications, creating a solid and smooth foundation for operations. You will work with Microsoft Azure as our infrastructure platform. You will be given significant responsibility and the opportunity to implement your ideas in a team-oriented environment.

Daily Tasks

• Building new features into our native cloud microservices Java platform

• Conducting thorough code reviews (e.g., pull-requests) and working closely with QA

• Integrating with partners to produce the best possible integrations

• Defining and implementing automated testing to support our CI & CD

• Defining architectural solutions and improvements for the services you work on

• Identifying and defining viable improvements to our way of working

• Designing solutions with IT colleagues and business counterparts

• Sharing knowledge and experiences with your team members and colleagues

Qualifications

• More than 4 years of experience in Java (primary programming language)

• Writing maintainable (clean, readable, reusable and well documented) code

• Extensive knowledge of software design patterns and principles

• Familiarity with relational and document databases. We use MongoDB

• Experience with microservices architecture and design-first principles of APIs

• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure as a platform

• Excellent English communication skills (company language)

• Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in CS / Software Engineering (or related fields)

Your profile

We tackle a wide range of projects, so if you love staying busy and enjoy variety in your workday, you'll fit right in with us. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and always go the extra mile to achieve your goals and meet deadlines.

Since we're not a large corporate IT department, you'll be given significant responsibility, making it crucial that you're comfortable making independent decisions when needed. You bring a positive and innovative mindset and aren't afraid to pitch and implement your ideas. You thrive in an informal environment and are eager to both learn more and share your knowledge. In short – you're a proactive “go-getter” who loves a challenge!

We look forward to hearing from you

If you have any questions, please contact IT manager Jesper Elgaard at jesper.elgaard@ubsend.com.

Please note that we are already covered by agencies in this area, and we are not interested in being contacted by external agencies regarding this vacancy.

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible. We’re doing ongoing interviews and will remove this listing once we’ve found the right new colleague.

**Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want significant technical ownership while continuing to build software hands-on.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us improve how we develop software – including how we use agentic AI to make capable developers more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work in a product team with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks by making good technical decisions, improving our architecture and development practices, and sharing knowledge with others.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing scalable, maintainable solutions and contributing to architectural decisions

• Improving our codebase, tooling, developer workflows, and technical quality

• Driving or contributing to initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure, architecture, or developer tooling

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or how we build them

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**Developing software with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

We are looking for developers who already use agentic AI as part of their development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Strong engineering fundamentals remain essential. AI can increase what a capable developer can achieve, but you remain responsible for the architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality of the software you build.

At Dalux, you will help us take these ways of working further by experimenting, sharing what works, and helping establish effective practices for agentic software development.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS. Our primary technologies include:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• GitHub Copilot

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

• AWS

• Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**Your background

**We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals

• Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions

• Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

• Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers

• Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, or cloud development is useful, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart. As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership and real influence on technical solutions

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve engineering practices beyond your immediate product work

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI for software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

**Interested?
